items.p2_explanation: VeriScan found a mix of competing signals in this frame: some characteristics resemble a genuine surveillance capture, while others are atypical enough to raise the possibility of alteration. The evidence is too evenly balanced for the model to commit either way, so it abstains.
items.p2_limitations: Borderline results are most common on low-resolution, compressed, or low-light footage, exactly the conditions where VeriScan is least reliable. An 'uncertain' verdict means the tool could not distinguish authentic from manipulated, not that the image is necessarily borderline in reality.

items.p2_explanation: The signals in this photograph point in both directions, some consistent with an ordinary camera capture and some suggestive of editing or generation, without either dominating. VeriScan therefore cannot make a confident determination and reports the result as uncertain.
items.p2_limitations: Images that have been resized, re-compressed, or lightly filtered can produce ambiguous signals that push VeriScan toward the uncertain range. The abstention reflects the limits of its analysis and should not be read as evidence for or against authenticity.

items.case_context: CCTV/surveillance still submitted in a criminal matter
items.p2_explanation: VeriScan detected patterns across this frame that are strongly associated with AI-generated or synthetically altered imagery, including frequency-domain artifacts uncharacteristic of a genuine camera sensor. The strength of these signals drives the high-confidence manipulation verdict.
items.p2_limitations: This model is most accurate on high-resolution images; on compressed surveillance footage it can occasionally mistake compression artifacts for signs of generation. High confidence reflects signal strength, not a guarantee of correctness.

items.p2_explanation: VeriScan found the visual and compression characteristics of this receipt consistent with an ordinary scan or photograph of a physical document, with no strong indicators of synthetic generation. This is why it reports the item as authentic with high confidence.
items.p2_limitations: VeriScan is an image-level detector and does not verify document content. It may not detect localised edits such as an altered number, date, or signature on receipts and printed text. An 'authentic' result means no generation signature was found, not that every detail is genuine.

Treat a confident verdict as a strong signal, not proof.
